item.tib: khro rgyal bder gshegs 'dus pa'i gsang bskangs
item.coloph: dbal chen gsang ba'i bskang (skong chung) 'di/ stag la me 'bar gyi thugs bcud/ khod spungs dran pa'i lung don/ stong chen dmu tsa gyer med kyis/ dus mtha'i rnal 'byor bdag la snyan du rgyud/ bdag gis sbas dang gsang rgya thub par byas/ dad ldan grogs po'i rkyen gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dkar chab (chag) yi ger ris su bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams lo mthol lo bshags/ bka' skyongs bsrang (srung) ma rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge bas 'gro kun bla med sa thob shog(shog/)
